artifact_observations.reasoning: The text labels on the click wheel (MENU, NEXT, PREV, PLAY/PAUSE) are extremely blurry and illegible. While this could be due to depth-of-field blur, AI generators often struggle to render this specific micro-text accurately, resulting in smudged glyphs rather than sharp letters.
Slight softness or 'melting' at the boundary where the click wheel meets the white casing. The transition lacks the crisp, hard-edge definition typical of manufactured plastic parts.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the click wheel. Real iPods have very specific, crisp sans-serif lettering. AI images often smear this into gibberish. Also, verify if the screen reflection looks physically accurate for a glossy glass surface versus a matte plastic one.
